name: webfolio-tooling
description: Lint and format tooling for the whole repository. The app itself is in frontend/ui and backend.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:prettier && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:java
scripts.lint:frontend: npm --prefix frontend/ui run stylelint:lint && npm --prefix frontend/ui run lint
scripts.fmt: npm run fmt:prettier && npm run fmt:frontend && npm run fmt:java
scripts.fmt:frontend: npm --prefix frontend/ui run stylelint:fix && npm --prefix frontend/ui run fmt
